name: Inferno

categories.label: Infamy track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm Infamy trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Position of your Infamy token (include +60/+120 token).

categories.label: Fraud cards (end-game effects)
categories.hint: Points from the chosen right-half effect of played Fraud cards whose Barrel requirement you meet.

categories.label: Diplomas (Phlegethon cube x Skull level)
categories.labelVi: Văn bằng (cube Phlegethon x cấp Skull)
categories.hint: For each diploma: Phlegethon cube value (1-5, after moving it left per empty shield) x your Skull level on that Sin Track (1-4). Enter each diploma.

categories.label: Charon's loans repayment
categories.hint: Points at your Boat square on the loan track: 0, -2 or -4. Enter as a negative number.

categories.label: Highest Tower
categories.hint: 4 Infamy for the tallest Tower (tied players each score).

categories.label: Most Florins
categories.hint: 3 Infamy for the most Florins (tied players each score).

categories.label: Most Guests
categories.hint: 4 Infamy for the most Guests hosted (tied players each score).

categories.label: Most family members at home
categories.labelVi: Nhiều thành viên gia đình ở nhà nhất
categories.hint: 3 Infamy for the most family members in your home (tied players each score).

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Final scoring order: Fraud cards, adjust Phlegethon cubes, extra diplomas from pairs of 1/2 Diploma tokens, score diplomas, repay Charon's loans, Florence reputation. No Reputation points in solo mode; solo scoring ranks and challenges not modelled. Sudden death early end changes final steps (see rulebook p.16).
